google_review_notes: Kids app for ages 3-8 (Designed for Families). No login, no accounts, no chat. Every purchase, Restore purchases and the privacy-policy link sit behind a parental gate: tap the lock (top corner of the home screen) and PRESS AND HOLD the correct answer to the multiplication shown (e.g. 7 x 8 = 56) for about 1.5 seconds. Free content: letters A-J (cards + tracing) and the Find the letter game. full_pack unlocks letters K-Z, the Big and little and First sound games and removes ads; remove_ads removes the banner only. Ads: AdMob banner only, child-directed (TFCD, TFUA, max rating G), never on tracing or game screens; no interstitial or rewarded ads, no notifications, no Play Games, no Firebase.
apple_review_notes: Kids app for ages 3-8. No login. Purchases and links are behind a parental gate: tap the lock on the home screen and press and hold the correct answer to the multiplication shown. Free: letters A-J and Find the letter; the one-time All letters & games purchase unlocks K-Z and two more games.
